top_articles.title: First local produce appear in Latvian markets
top_articles.summary: Latvian farmers have begun selling this year’s new harvest. The first strawberries, the first new potatoes, as well as this season’s beets and carrots, are already available at the market. Prices for the first vegetable and berry harvest are traditionally high, Kurzeme Television reported on May 27.

top_articles.title: US Congressman Don Bacon receives Latvian state award
top_articles.summary: May 27th saw Latvian President Edgars Rinkēvičs presenting Latvia’s highest state award – the Order of the Three Stars – to Don Bacon, a member of the U.S. Congress House of Representatives and long-time co-chair of the Baltic Caucus.

top_articles.summary: Lenkijos pasieniečiai pranešė apie dar vieną neteisėtos migracijos atvejį pasienyje su Lietuva. Per vieną dieną Podlaskės vaivadijoje sulaikyta 14 užsieniečių, neteisėtai kirtusių Lietuvos ir Lenkijos sieną, skelbia miastosuwalki.pl.
